name: W2 — Chat with your PDF (Docling to pgvector)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sources: [{ kind: 'file', base64_string: $json.pdf_base64, filename: 'synthetic.pdf' }], options: { to_formats: ['md'] } }) }}

nodes.name: Parse with Docling
nodes.notes: BYTES ONLY. Docling's URL fetching is disabled and it sits on a network with no route off the host. It is the component most likely to be executing something an attacker wrote, so it sees one caller and nothing else.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO w2_chunks (source, content, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::vector)

nodes.name: Store chunk + embedding
nodes.notes: One datastore, one backup procedure. Retention deletes a document AND its embeddings in the SAME transaction — a vector that outlives its source is a deleted document you can still search.
